com.vector.cfg.gen.core.bswmdmodel.groovy.api

Interface IBswmdModelApiEntryPoint


  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IBswmdModelApiEntryPoint
    IBswmdModelApiEntryPoint provides methods which allow retrieving BswmdModel objects in different ways .

    The bswmdModel() methods provide entry points to start navigation through the ActiveEcuc. Client code can use the Closure overloads to navigate into the content of the found bswmd objects. Inside the called closure the related bswmd object is available as closure parameter.

    The following types of entry points are provided here:

    • bswmdModel(WrappedTypedDefRef) searches all objects with the specified definition and returns the BswmdModel instances.
    • bswmdModel(Class) searches all objects with the specified class and returns the BswmdModel instances. Finds the same elements as above.
    • bswmdModel(MIHasDefinition, WrappedTypedDefRef) returns the BswmdModel instance for the provided MDF model instance.
    • bswmdModel(Class, String) searches all objects with the specified class and the matching path, see IMdfModelApi.mdfModel(String) or chapter for details.

      • bswmdModel

        @PublishedMethod
<BSWMD extends GIModelObject> java.util.List<BSWMD> bswmdModel(java.lang.Class<BSWMD> bswmdModelClass,
                                                                                 java.lang.String path)
        Searches for model elements as specified in IMdfModelApi.mdfModel(String).

        The bswmdModelClass is either a GIXXX class like. GIContainer, or a generated classes like Dio. 

         
 def dioGeneral = bswmdModel(DioGeneral, "/ActiveEcuc/MyDio/MyDioGeneral").single

        This method limits the search to the ActiveEcuC.

        Type Parameters:
        BSWMD - the (expected) model object type
        Parameters:
        path - to search for see IMdfModelApi.mdfModel(String) for details
        Returns:
        The found objects

      • bswmdModel

        @PublishedMethod
<CFG extends com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.model.autosar.ecucdescription.MIHasDefinition,BSWMD extends GIModelObject> BSWMD bswmdModel(IHasModelObject obj,
                                                                                                                                                    WrappedTypedDefRef<?,CFG,?,BSWMD> defRef)
        Returns the found bswmd object from the passed IHasModelObject domain model object.
        You can switch from domain models to the BswmdModel, if the domain model is backed by ActiveEcuC elements. Please read the documentation of the different domain models, for whether this is possible for a certain domain model. To switch from a domain model to the BswmdModel, you can call one of the methods for IHasModelObjects like, bswmdModel(IHasModelObject, WrappedTypedDefRef). But you need a DefRef to get the type safe BswmdModel object. The domain model documents, which DefRef must be used for the certain domain model object. 
         
 // Domain model object of the communication domain
 ICanController canDomainModel = ...

 def canControllerBswmd = canDomainModel.bswmdModel(CanController.DefRef)

 // Or use a closure
 canDomainModel.bswmdModel(CanController.DefRef){ canControllerBswmd ->
   //Use the bswmd object
 }
        Type Parameters:
        CFG - the MDF model type
        BSWMD - the bswmd model instance type
        Parameters:
        obj - the MDF model object to use
        defRef - an definition of the passed MDF object.
        Returns:
        The found bswmd object

      • bswmdModel

        @PublishedMethod
GIContainer bswmdModel(com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.model.autosar.ecucdescription.MIContainer obj)
        Returns the found bswmd object from the passed MIContainer MDF model element.

        This allows you to access the BswmdModel by MDF model objects in a generic way, without knowing a DefRef. This is handy, if you want traverse an unknown Ecu configuration structure.

        Note: If you know a DefRef please use the other methods like bswmdModel(MIHasDefinition, WrappedTypedDefRef) instead!

        Parameters:
        obj - the MDF model object to use
        defRef - an definition of the passed MDF object.
        Returns:
        The found bswmd object
        See Also:
        bswmdModel(MIModuleConfiguration), bswmdModel(MIHasDefinition, WrappedTypedDefRef)
